concern_summary: This concern involves the verification of outstanding reports and the computation of transaction differences based on currency, aiming to ensure that reports reflect current and accurate financial data related to the user\u2019s bank account.
Display and processing of status updates within money reports, highlighting relevant financial details.

This concern focuses on the financial metric updates necessary for managing input and output transactions, including both updating the total amounts of reports and calculating differences based on currency and transaction changes.
This concern encapsulates the handling, display, and management of invoice reports, including verifying their status, adjusting payment options, and managing UI elements specific to invoices.
This concern centers on determining and validating currency types, ensuring monetary calculations and displays are accurate and consistent across transaction contexts.
This concern focuses on the creation and management of invoice-related reports, including building optimistic reports and handling associated transactions and participant details.
This concern addresses the currency associated with policies, ensuring the correct display of monetary values and handling conversions related to policies.
This concern manages the processing and state updates of payment requests linked to invoice reports.
This concern focuses on converting amounts in cents to appropriately formatted string representations, considering various currency types and locale preferences.
